about_the_game:
Welcome to bloody summer camp.
An upcoming multiplayer summer camp slasher game...

  • In this asymmetric multiplayer horror experience; one player takes on the role of the Slasher, a terrifying killer and the remaining players, up to seven Counselors; should escape from the campsite.

  •  Play as the Slasher— The Slasher is always hunting. Use your supernatural abilities to track, trap, and eliminate each Counselor one by one. No mercy.
    Unleash your inner maniac with brutal environmental kill scenes.

  •  Play as a Counselor — As a Counselor, your goal is survival; explore the map to find and collect key items, solve puzzles and repair escape vehicles such as a car, a boat or even call for the police. Teamwork is optional, betrayal is always a risk.

  • Sandbox Mode — Unlike traditional gameplay, Sandbox Mode offers a more relaxed, open-ended experience. Allows players to freely explore maps, interact without pressure and create their own scenarios and stories. Whether you're roleplaying a campfire gathering or just hanging out with friends, Sandbox Mode provides a space for creativity and fun!

This game is being developed by indie developers, to support our project follow the Kickstarter page :]

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 2GB / AMD HD 7870 2GB (with Vulkan support)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Quad-Core or Apple Silicon (via Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
